Quick intro: I’m Samir, Head of Partnerships at TraceHook. We built lightweight tracing and prompt-level instrumentation that sits alongside LlamaIndex adapters; several ISVs use it to capture per-request prompt transformations, cached prefix hits, and latency breakdowns.

We’d love to run a short pilot with Redwood to validate a bundled offering: 1) a TraceHook adapter for Redwood’s LlamaIndex runtime, 2) automatic span export to Redwood Console (for token-level latency), and 3) a small SDK shim so customers can opt-in to richer tracing without changing their prompt code.

Attached is a two-page summary and a small patch that demonstrates an adapter hook. High-level asks: a 4–6 week technical pilot, a Redwood engineering point-of-contact, and a brief NDA (if needed) so we can share a test harness with sample data.

If this sounds reasonable, can we schedule a 30-minute sync next week to align on scope?

Samir — thanks for the discussion earlier. Recap and agreed pilot scope below.

Recap / Pilot scope (4 weeks):
- Integration: TraceHook will deliver an adapter that hooks into our LlamaIndex runtime (v0.8.x) and emits token counters, cache hit events, and per-step latency spans to a NDJSON endpoint.
- Privacy: Default payloads will omit user identifiers; Redwood will provide a redaction policy file for the adapter (no PII in transmitted traces).
- Delivery: TraceHook to open a PR to our integrations repo; Redwood infra (Priyom) will provide a staging cluster and example prompt vector set.
- Observability: Redwood Console will ingest spans for a sample account; we’ll produce a sample dashboard and an alert rule for abnormal token amplification.

Action items / owners:
- TraceHook (Samir): PR with adapter + brief runbook (target: 12/10)
- Redwood Eng (Priyom): staging LlamaIndex runtime + access (target: 12/08)
- Partnerships (Marissa): pilot SOW + NDA (if TraceHook prefers) (target: 12/06)
- Sales (Ben): pilot commercial terms (90-day tech pilot) and marketplace intake (target: 12/11)

Attachments: redwood-llamaindex-integration-checklist.xlsx (checklist of infra & access) and tracehook-sdk-adapter-diff.patch (example shim).

Let me know if any of the owners need to shift dates, otherwise I’ll circulate a short SOW and calendar invites early next week.
